name: Shamator Town
description: Headquarters of Shamator district, the 16th and one of the newest districts of Nagaland formed in 2022 from parts of Tuensang and Kiphire, known as the Brotherhood District and home to Yimkhiung and Tikhir Naga tribes.
facts: Lies in Shamator district, Nagaland at about 1800 m elevation
Created as district HQ on 4 March 2022
Base for exploring Zungki River and surrounding Yimkhiung villages
Sources: Wikipedia, shamator.nic.in

name: Zungki River
description: Largest tributary of the Tizu River flowing through Shamator district, offering scenic gorges, blue waters, sandy banks in dry season, and opportunities for picnics, angling and photography in a remote hilly setting.
facts: Official tourist place listed on shamator.nic.in as natural/scenic beauty
Originates near Changdong forest and flows south through Noklak, Shamator and Kiphire before joining Tizu
Part of the proposed Tizu-Zungki National Waterway (NW-101)
Coordinates approximate for the Shamator section; Sources: official NIC, Wikipedia

name: Yakor Village
description: Yimkhiung Naga village about 12 km from Shamator town, offering authentic tribal culture, traditional houses, agricultural fields and scenic ridge views in the eastern hills.
facts: Lies in Shamator district, Nagaland; population about 1078 (2011)
Known for traditional Yimkhiung lifestyle and crafts
Accessible as a cultural day visit from Shamator HQ
Sources: Wikipedia, Census 2011, OSM

name: Sangphur Village
description: One of the larger villages in Shamator circle with a population over 2300, featuring traditional Naga settlement patterns, community life and proximity to the district headquarters for cultural immersion.
facts: Lies in Shamator district, Nagaland; population 2314 (2011)
About 10 km from Shamator HQ
Part of the official recognized villages list
Sources: Census, shamator.nic.in, postal data

name: Chessore
description: Sub-divisional headquarters and village cluster in Shamator district, serving as an administrative and cultural center for the Chessore area with surrounding villages and local festivals.
facts: Lies in Shamator district, Nagaland; Chessore Sub-Division
Host to local sports meets and community events
Part of Shamator-Chessore assembly constituency
Sources: official NIC village lists, OSM, local reports

name: Shamator Village
description: Historic village adjacent to the district headquarters, inhabited primarily by Yimkhiung Nagas, offering insights into traditional architecture, community life and the area's tribal heritage.
facts: Lies in Shamator district, Nagaland; population about 1159 (2011)
Recognized village listed on official district site
Close to HQ for easy cultural visits
Coordinates approximate; Sources: Census, shamator.nic.in

name: Metümnyo Festival Grounds
description: Venue for the traditional five-day harvest festival of the Yimkhiung tribe held in August after millet harvest, featuring communal rituals, dances, youth engagements and prayers for the departed.
facts: Celebrated in the second week of August in Shamator district
Includes cleaning rituals, path repairs and soul prayers
Official festival listed on shamator.nic.in
Best experienced during festival period; Sources: official NIC

name: Zungki River Valley Picnic Spot
description: Wide valley basin along the Zungki River near Shamator offering flat sandy areas for family picnics, shallow pools and views of surrounding forested hills in a peaceful remote setting.
facts: Popular local day-trip destination in Shamator district
Features sandy banks and forest surroundings
Accessible from Shamator town via river crossings
Coordinates approximate; Sources: local tourism descriptions, official river page
